predictability.label: high
predictability.rule: FCF > 0 in ≥ 80% of years and margin stdev ≤ 3 pts

asset_intensity.label: moderate
asset_intensity.rule: between the light and heavy rules

plan.summary: Mature grower, predictable cash flows (moderate assets, low leverage) → DCF primary, comps cross-check.

methods.name: DCF (Standalone)
methods.reason: predictable, positive free cash flow makes cash flows the most direct measure

methods.name: Public Comps: Sector Peers
methods.reason: mature grower with low leverage: enterprise multiples compare cleanly

methods.name: Public Comps: Closest Match
methods.reason: peers closest on growth, margin, leverage, size and beta from anywhere in the sector: a check on the sector set

methods.name: Public Comps: Synthesized Firm
methods.reason: peers weighted to match the target's growth, discount rate, margin and leverage (the course's synthesized firm): a check on both sets

methods.name: DCF with Synergies
methods.reason: value to a buyer, synergies included: an offer price, not a standalone value

methods.name: Just Synergies
methods.reason: pre-announcement price plus the synergies: an offer price, not a standalone value

methods.name: LBO
methods.reason: what a financial buyer could pay given the cash flows and debt capacity

methods.name: Precedent Transactions
methods.reason: includes a control premium; not a standalone value

exit_multiple.label: Implied exit EV/EBITDA vs public comps
exit_multiple.note: 22.8x against a comps average of 9.4x (+143%): exit multiples are usually too high; check the terminal inputs

margin.note: EBITDA margin 25.2% vs peers' 16.9%: at or above normal, so cost synergies shouldn't last forever

headlines.answer: HSY is worth about $160.91 a share (range $103.69–$298.57), 7% below the $172.56 share price.
headlines.field: The methods are 141% apart: sector comps gives $87.22, the DCF $210.03, so the weights decide the answer.
headlines.spread: 80% of 2,000 simulated runs land between $126.48 and $421.99; about 50% of runs are above the $172.56 price.
headlines.sensitivity: Each 0.5-point change in the discount rate moves value about $56.28 a share; the grid spans $111.42–$1,108.50.
headlines.comps: Sector peers imply $87.22 a share (range $69.51–$113.44); the 6 peers closest on fundamentals give $144.82, 66% more.
headlines.dcf: The DCF's $210.03 a share rests 77% on the terminal value.
